title: Postdoctoral Fellowship
institution: Mansueto Institute for Urban Innovation, University of Chicago
field: Urban science (economics, sociology, public policy, urban planning, data science)
about: One-year, full-time postdoctoral fellowship at the University of Chicago Mansueto Institute, renewable for a second year. Applications for 2027-2028 close December 6, 2026; awards are announced in spring 2027.
requirements: PhD from outside the University of Chicago by the start date; recent UChicago graduates are excluded
Supervision by a UChicago faculty member and their department or school
Backgrounds include economics, political science, sociology, public policy, urban planning and data science
